title: Local handyman marketplace
summary: Book trusted local tradespeople on demand.
whyItFails: Disintermediation. After the first job, customers go direct. Supply quality. Good tradies are busy and don't need you. Low frequency. Homeowners need help occasionally.
whatWouldChange: Software for tradies (scheduling, payments) that makes staying on-platform worth it.

attempts.notes: Cleaners and handymen on demand; cited profitability problems, worker-classification lawsuits and workers leaving for direct arrangements with clients.
Marketplace for cleaning and home services.

reasons.detail: Disintermediation: After the first job, customers go direct.
Supply quality: Good tradies are busy and don't need you.
Low frequency: Homeowners need help occasionally.
